messages:
maria: quick ask — can someone run a bench comparing FlashAttention v1 vs v2 with paged attention and fused ops? need aggregated latency + mem + throughput for long sequences. Target: GPT-J 6B, seq=8192, batch=1. Please include driver/cuda versions and perf traces if possible. cc @shawn @kai

shawn: I can take p4d runs tomorrow morning. do you want fused ops on/off and paged on/off permutations? :eyes:

maria: yes — permutations: (1) flash_v1 no-paged no-fused, (2) flash_v2 no-paged fused, (3) flash_v2 paged fused, (4) flash_v2 paged no-fused. also one synthetic microbench that isolates the attention kernel (no model IO).

kai: will add a microbench to perf infra. lightweight, should run in ~5m on CI. I’ll add a job matrix for cuda11/cuda12 and driver variants.

alex: local command I used previously for a run (attach `--trace` to collect nvtx/nvprof traces):
```
./perf/run.sh --model gpt-j --seq 8192 --batch 1 --kernel flash_v2 --paged true --fused true --cuda 12.1 --driver 535.104
```
attach traces to S3 with `--artifact s3://redwood-artifacts/bench/`

lina: heads up — last week we saw a regression with fused+paged on cuda12; include a run on cuda11 for comparison and collect `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` and driver versions.

devops-bot: scheduled benchmark job 3421 on p4d-us-west-2 for thread 1772123345. ETA ~30m

shawn: started job 3421. streaming logs: https://redwood-artifacts.s3.amazonaws.com/bench/3421/log.txt

ci-bot: benchmark 3421 finished. summary: model=gpt-j seq=8192 kernel=flash_v2 paged=true fused=true p50=118ms p99=205ms throughput=8.6 tokens/s mem=30.7GB. artifacts: https://redwood-artifacts.s3.amazonaws.com/bench/3421/

maria: solid. can someone upload the raw perf traces to /artifacts/attn/1772123345 and add a minimal repro script (single-file) that runs just attention with same params? we want a tiny repro for bisecting kernels.

kai: pushing a minimal repro to github: https://github.com/redwood/attn-repro/commit/abcd123 (branch flash-paged-fusion). includes `repro.py` + `run.sh` and a small instruction.md

alex: opened PR adding the microbench and CI job matrix: https://github.com/redwood/redwood-ci/pull/1487 — adds cuda11/cuda12 permutations and artifact upload step.

maria: perfect. I’ll review the PR and the repro tomorrow morning and prioritize a bisect if the traces show divergence. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
